name: Mail
about: Reads and sends your Gmail with your own Google OAuth client.

settings.name: email
settings.label: Gmail address
settings.obtain: The address you signed in with when you made the refresh token.

settings.name: clientId
settings.label: OAuth client ID
settings.obtain: Google Cloud console: enable the Gmail API (and, for address suggestions, the People API), set up the OAuth consent screen with yourself as a test user, then Credentials, Create credentials, OAuth client ID, type Desktop app.

settings.name: clientSecret
settings.label: OAuth client secret
settings.obtain: Shown with the client ID when the OAuth client is made.

settings.name: refreshToken
settings.label: Refresh token
settings.obtain: Grant your client the scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.modify (and optionally directory.readonly and contacts.other.readonly) once on a computer, for example with Google's OAuth 2.0 Playground set to use your own client, and copy the refresh token it gives.

limits: Google expires refresh tokens after 7 days while the OAuth consent screen is in Testing; publish it (it needs no review for your own use) to keep the login.
Address suggestions from your organisation and saved contacts need the People API and their scopes; without them only people from your mail are suggested.

delta.about: The command center keeps the Gmail login (GET /gmail-login, set with `delta gmail login`); the phone still talks to Gmail itself.
